desc: Read input, perform coordinate compression of all A_i and X_i values.
Build Fenwick tree (BIT) supporting range maximum query and point update.
Process array A sequentially, updating BIT with DP transitions for each element.
Group queries by their R value; after processing each prefix i, answer all queries with that R using BIT prefix query up to compressed X.
Output answers in original query order.
Sanity check with the provided samples; ensure strict inequality is correctly handled.
Consider edge cases: X larger than all values, duplicate values, R = N, etc.
